name: Change vehicle details on a V5C registration certificate
description: Process for notifying DVLA of mistakes or specified vehicle changes so the V5C log book can be updated, with supporting evidence where required.
applicant_type: Registered keeper of a vehicle who needs to correct mistakes on a V5C or report specified changes made to the vehicle
caseworker_type: DVLA vehicle registration casework team handling V5C amendments and related inspection referrals

application_tracks.track: Postal V5C update for engine size, fuel type, weight of a goods vehicle, or number of seats on a bus
application_tracks.fee_detail: No application fee stated for updating the V5C by post; £25 only mentioned if a replacement log book is needed after 6 weeks and DVLA was not notified
application_tracks.processing_time: Up to 2 to 4 weeks to get a replacement certificate if applying by post
additional_requirements: Fill in section 1 on a new style log book with multi-coloured numbered blocks on the front cover, or section 7 on an older style log book

application_tracks.track: Postal V5C update for all other listed vehicle changes
application_tracks.fee_detail: No application fee stated for updating the V5C by post; £25 only mentioned if a replacement log book is needed after 6 weeks and DVLA was not notified
application_tracks.processing_time: Up to 2 to 4 weeks to get a replacement certificate if applying by post
additional_requirements: Fill in section 1 on a new style log book with multi-coloured numbered blocks on the front cover, or section 7 on an older style log book
If the change is not listed in section 1 or 7, add notes to the 'vehicle details' section
Send evidence and a letter explaining the change if not listed in section 1 or 7

application_tracks.track: Postal notification of like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or motorcycle frame replacement without changing original appearance or dimensions
application_tracks.processing_time: Not specifically stated; general postal replacement certificate timeline is up to 2 to 4 weeks
additional_requirements: Tell DVLA using a Vehicle parts statement (V627/1)
Provide specified supporting documents and photos

application_tracks.track: Postal V5C update for structural modification or electric conversion
application_tracks.processing_time: Not specifically stated; general postal replacement certificate timeline is up to 2 to 4 weeks
additional_requirements: Send evidence of a current MOT if the vehicle needs one
Send motorcycle single vehicle approval (MSVA) if the motorcycle needs one

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C to tell DVLA about mistakes on the V5C
eligibility_criteria.details: Mistakes on the registration certificate must be corrected by updating the V5C

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C for most changes made to the vehicle
eligibility_criteria.details: Specified changes include colour, engine cylinder capacity (cc), fuel type, seating capacity, weight of a large vehicle, chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or motorcycle frame where size or appearance is different from when the vehicle was made
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Like-for-like replacement of chassis, combined chassis and bodyshell, or motorcycle frame without changing original appearance or dimensions does not require updating the V5C, but DVLA must still be told using V627/1

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Tax class cannot be changed by updating the V5C
eligibility_criteria.details: Tax class must be changed by changing vehicle tax, including where changing to an exempt tax class such as 'disabled'

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing colour
Applicant must update the V5C when changing engine cylinder capacity
eligibility_criteria.details: Engine cylinder capacity is specified as cc

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing fuel type
eligibility_criteria.details: Includes conversion to run on electricity

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing seating capacity
eligibility_criteria.details: Seating capacity change must be notified

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing the weight of a large vehicle
eligibility_criteria.details: Examples given are goods vehicle or campervan

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or motorcycle frame if size or appearance is different from when the vehicle was made
eligibility_criteria.details: Structural changes affecting size or appearance require V5C update
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: If original look and size are not changed, do not update the V5C but notify DVLA using V627/1

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must tell DVLA about like-for-like restoration or replacement of chassis, combined chassis and bodyshell, or motorcycle frame
eligibility_criteria.details: Even if original appearance or dimensions do not change, DVLA must be told using Vehicle parts statement (V627/1)
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: No exemption from notifying DVLA is stated

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing wheel plan
eligibility_criteria.details: Wheel plan change may need inspection

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing body type
eligibility_criteria.details: Example given is converting a van to a campervan or 'motor caravan'; DVLA gives a body type description based on the vehicle's external appearance

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must update the V5C when changing vehicle identification number, chassis number, or frame number for motorbikes
eligibility_criteria.details: VIN, chassis number, and frame number changes may need inspection

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Applicant must provide evidence or written confirmation for specified changes
eligibility_criteria.details: V5C update will be rejected if evidence is not provided for listed changes

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Structural modification includes alteration of original dimensions or appearance involving chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame
eligibility_criteria.details: If original dimensions or appearance are altered and any of chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame are involved, it is a structural modification

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Electric conversion counts as a modification
eligibility_criteria.details: If a vehicle is converted to run on electricity, it counts as a modification

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Current MOT evidence is required if the vehicle needs one
eligibility_criteria.details: MOT evidence only required where the vehicle needs an MOT
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Vehicles that do not need an MOT

eligibility_criteria.criterion: Motorcycle single vehicle approval is required if the motorcycle needs one
eligibility_criteria.exemptions: Motorcycles that do not need MSVA

evidence_requirements.name: Receipt for the replacement engine
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required as one of the acceptable documents for change of engine number or cylinder capacity (cc)
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check receipt includes the engine number and cylinder capacity
evidence_requirements.notes: Must include engine number and cylinder capacity

evidence_requirements.name: Written evidence from the manufacturer
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Accepted for change of engine number or cylinder capacity (cc)
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check manufacturer evidence supports engine number or cylinder capacity change

evidence_requirements.name: Inspection report provided for insurance purposes
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Accepted for change of engine number or cylinder capacity (cc)
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check report identifies the relevant engine change details
evidence_requirements.notes: Must be an inspection report provided for insurance purposes

evidence_requirements.name: Written confirmation on headed paper from a garage
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Accepted for change of engine number or cylinder capacity if the change took place before the applicant bought the vehicle; also required for fuel type change where existing engine is converted
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check headed paper and that garage confirms the work/change
evidence_requirements.notes: For fuel type conversion, confirmation must be on headed paper from the garage that did the work

evidence_requirements.name: Receipt for a new engine fitted
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for change of fuel type where a new engine is fitted
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check receipt supports new engine installation

evidence_requirements.name: Evidence of electric conversion
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required where the vehicle has been converted to run on electricity
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check submitted evidence supports electric conversion
evidence_requirements.notes: Specific document type not fully specified in the fuel type section; structural modification/electric conversion section requires V627/3 and possibly MOT/MSVA

evidence_requirements.name: Latest V5C registration certificate
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required if chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame has been replaced without changing dimensions or appearance since first made; alternative is V62 application form
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check latest V5C accompanies the notification
evidence_requirements.notes: Can be replaced by V62 application form if latest V5C not available

evidence_requirements.name: V62 application form
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Alternative to latest V5C registration certificate for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement without change to dimensions or appearance
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check form is completed and submitted
evidence_requirements.notes: Used where latest V5C is not provided

evidence_requirements.name: V627/1 Vehicle parts statement
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required when replacing chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame without changing original look and size; also used to tell DVLA about like-for-like changes where V5C does not need updating
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check form is completed and matches declared parts changes
evidence_requirements.notes: Scraped text contains a stray apostrophe in 'Vehicle parts statement’ (V627/1)

evidence_requirements.name: V5C of the vehicle that any replacement part comes from
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required if replacement parts used in like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement are not new parts
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check donor vehicle V5C corresponds to replacement part source
evidence_requirements.notes: Only needed if not using new parts

evidence_requirements.name: Invoice or receipt including the specification of the replacement chassis
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement without change to dimensions or appearance
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check specification of replacement chassis is included
evidence_requirements.notes: Original or photocopy can be sent

evidence_requirements.name: Photos of the whole vehicle, including front, back, sides, interior and registration number plate
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement without change to dimensions or appearance
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check all listed views are included
evidence_requirements.notes: Must include front, back, sides, interior and registration number plate

evidence_requirements.name: Photo of the vehicle's engine number
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement without change to dimensions or appearance
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check engine number is visible in photo

evidence_requirements.name: Photo of the vehicle registration identification number (VIN) stamp or plate on the old chassis or frame being replaced
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement without change to dimensions or appearance
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check VIN stamp or plate is visible and relates to old chassis or frame

evidence_requirements.name: Photo of the old VIN sticker
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement without change to dimensions or appearance
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check old VIN sticker is visible
evidence_requirements.notes: Usually found near the driver's door or on the dashboard near the windscreen on the driver's side

evidence_requirements.name: V627/3 modified vehicle statement
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required if the applicant has made a structural modification or electric conversion
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check statement includes the registration number and details of the modification
evidence_requirements.notes: Must include registration number and details of the modification

evidence_requirements.name: Evidence of a current MOT
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for structural modification or electric conversion if the vehicle needs an MOT
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check MOT is current

evidence_requirements.name: Motorcycle single vehicle approval (MSVA)
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required for structural modification or electric conversion if the motorcycle needs one
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check MSVA is provided where applicable

evidence_requirements.name: Plating certificate
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required as one of the acceptable documents when changing the weight of a large vehicle
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check certificate supports revised vehicle weight
evidence_requirements.notes: Alternative is a design weight certificate

evidence_requirements.name: Design weight certificate
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required as one of the acceptable documents when changing the weight of a large vehicle
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check certificate supports revised vehicle weight

evidence_requirements.name: Letter explaining the change
evidence_requirements.conditional_on: Required where the change is not listed in section 1 or section 7 of the V5C
evidence_requirements.verification_method: Check letter explains the unlisted change

workflow_stages.stage: Identify whether the change must be reported
workflow_stages.description: Determine whether the issue is a mistake on the V5C, a reportable vehicle change, a like-for-like replacement requiring V627/1 only, or a tax class change that must be handled through vehicle tax instead.
decision_points: Is it a mistake on the V5C?
Is it one of the listed vehicle changes?
Is it a tax class change instead of a V5C change?
Is it a like-for-like chassis/monocoque bodyshell/frame replacement without change to original look and size?
caseworker_actions: Assess whether the reported change falls within V5C amendment scope
Identify whether V5C update is required or whether V627/1 notification is the correct route
Identify whether inspection may be needed

workflow_stages.description: Applicant collects the required evidence or written confirmation for the specific change.
decision_points: Has the applicant provided one of the acceptable documents for engine number or cylinder capacity change?
Has the applicant provided the correct evidence for fuel type change?
Is the change a structural modification or electric conversion requiring V627/3 and possibly MOT/MSVA?
Is the weight change supported by a plating certificate or design weight certificate?
caseworker_actions: Check that required evidence is present
Reject V5C update if required evidence is missing
Assess whether evidence supports the declared change

workflow_stages.description: Applicant completes the relevant section of the log book or uses the appropriate supporting form.
decision_points: Is the log book new style or older style?
Is the change listed in section 1 or section 7?
Is V62 needed instead of latest V5C?
Is V627/1 or V627/3 required?
caseworker_actions: Check section 1 is used for new style log books
Check section 7 is used for older style log books
Check notes were added to the 'vehicle details' section where needed
Check explanatory letter is included for unlisted changes

workflow_stages.stage: Postal submission to correct DVLA address
workflow_stages.description: Applicant sends the V5C and evidence to the relevant DVLA Swansea address.
decision_points: Does the change fall under SA99 1DZ routing?
Does the change fall under SA99 1BA routing?
caseworker_actions: Confirm correspondence was routed to the correct address
Associate evidence with the V5C amendment request

workflow_stages.description: DVLA reviews the change and decides whether to confirm it or require inspection.
decision_points: Can the change be confirmed on the evidence submitted?
Does the change need an inspection?
Does the change mean more vehicle tax is payable?
caseworker_actions: Review evidence against the declared change
Determine whether inspection is required for changes such as wheel plan, body type, VIN, chassis number, or frame number
Notify applicant of confirmation, inspection requirement, or tax implications

workflow_stages.description: DVLA issues a replacement V5C showing the updated details.
workflow_stages.typical_duration: Up to 2 to 4 weeks if applying by post
decision_points: Has the replacement certificate been issued within 4 weeks?
Has the applicant contacted DVLA after 4 weeks?
Has 6 weeks passed without applicant notifying DVLA?
caseworker_actions: Handle follow-up where certificate not received
Apply £25 replacement charge if more than 6 weeks have passed and applicant did not notify DVLA

possible_outcomes: V5C updated and replacement certificate issued
DVLA requests or arranges an inspection
Applicant is told the change means more vehicle tax must be paid
V5C update rejected due to missing required evidence
Applicant redirected to change vehicle tax instead of updating tax class on V5C
Replacement log book not received within 4 weeks and applicant contacts DVLA
Replacement log book requested after 6 weeks without prior notification and £25 replacement fee applies

typical_timeline.inside_uk: Up to 2 to 4 weeks to get a replacement certificate if applying by post

communication_touchpoints.trigger: DVLA has reviewed the submitted change
communication_touchpoints.content_summary: DVLA confirms the change or tells the applicant if it needs an inspection

communication_touchpoints.trigger: DVLA determines the change affects vehicle tax
communication_touchpoints.content_summary: DVLA tells the applicant if the change means they have to pay more vehicle tax

communication_touchpoints.trigger: Applicant has not received the log book after applying by post
communication_touchpoints.content_summary: Applicant should contact DVLA if the log book has not been received and it has been 4 weeks since applying

communication_touchpoints.trigger: Applicant has not received the log book after 6 weeks and did not notify DVLA
communication_touchpoints.content_summary: Applicant will have to pay £25 to get a replacement if they did not notify DVLA within 6 weeks

risk_indicators.indicator: Required evidence or written confirmation missing for a listed change
Applicant attempts to change tax class by updating the V5C
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Redirect applicant to the vehicle tax change process

risk_indicators.indicator: Structural modification or electric conversion declared without V627/3 modified vehicle statement
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Do not process amendment until required evidence is provided

risk_indicators.indicator: Vehicle may require inspection due to wheel plan, body type, VIN, chassis number, or motorbike frame number change
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Refer for inspection decision and notify applicant

risk_indicators.indicator: Like-for-like chassis, monocoque bodyshell, or frame replacement reported as a standard V5C update instead of V627/1 notification
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Correct the route and request V627/1 and associated evidence/photos

risk_indicators.indicator: Replacement parts are not new and donor vehicle V5C is missing
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Request or require the V5C of the vehicle that the replacement part comes from

risk_indicators.indicator: Photos do not show all required views or identifiers
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Request complete photo set showing whole vehicle, engine number, VIN stamp or plate, and old VIN sticker

risk_indicators.indicator: Application sent to wrong DVLA Swansea address
risk_indicators.caseworker_action: Reroute internally if possible or advise applicant of correct address

No service standard for inspection cases is stated
No channel is stated for DVLA communications such as whether contact is by letter, email, phone, or SMS
No refusal review, reconsideration, complaint, or appeal process is described
No identity verification requirements for the registered keeper are described
No detailed evidence list is provided for change of body type to motor caravan; content only refers to checking separate guidance

No specific evidence document is named for electric conversion in the fuel type section beyond general evidence; more specific requirements appear only in the structural modification/electric conversion section
No definition is given for what counts as a 'large vehicle' beyond examples such as campervan, goods vehicle, and bus seating changes
No exact inspection criteria are given, only that DVLA will tell the applicant if inspection is needed
No replacement certificate dispatch method is stated
No explicit handling instructions are given for mistakes on the V5C beyond the general update process
No details are given on whether photocopies are accepted for documents other than the invoice or receipt for replacement chassis
No exact form completion fields are provided for section 1, section 7, V62, V627/1, or V627/3
